text: Nancy Guthrie search: What does the masked person's outfit reveal? | Jesse Weber LiveScott Rouse, a body language expert, and Steve Wolf, a firearms safety expert, join “Jesse Weber Live” to discuss the actions of the masked man caught on Nancy Guthrie’s camera outside her home.
